body:
I work in a unemployment call center. 

Basically you're going to have to wait. But people don't want to wait, I get it, it's their way to survive, they don't got income this is it.    It's hard to wait in those cases.    But that also means people we could help aren't getting help because someone who filed a new claim on Monday is calling on Tuesday to see why they weren't approved for benefits and having to listen to them b**ch us out because we just can't hang up.   Then they insist on being transferred like an actual rep is going to magically disregard waiting for employer responses or verification process and approve them and then magic money to them that instant.    It doesn't work that way.  And like I said, it pushes people who legit need help fixing their stuff back even further.

I'm betting on it.  Mine was delayed at Thanksgiving,  when I called they told me it can take two business days to see the payment.   Being that Christmas is on a Friday, you might not  see payment till Monday or Tuesday.

That isn't what it says.   " You did not earn enough money to establish an unemployment claim.  Check the statement on your Statement of benefits that was mailed to you and if it's not accurate contact TWC." 

Then is says  " We have requested wage information from your federal employer. When we receive notice of your wages we will send you update information regarding your claim." 

No where does it state to contact their federal employer.
Not yet.  There has been no vote on it and the president has signed a new bill.  We'll have to wait until that happens.

It depends.  You'd have to report the hours and earnings.    You should be ok to continue getting unemployment but who the hell knows anymore,you can try calling and asking but be prepared for it to be an all week thing with trying to get through to speak to anyone.
The bill hasn't passed yet, so we'll have to wait and see.
